notes: INSIDE half of the Salvage Intake Mk1 (standard, 4x2): a glass-fronted sorting hopper with a belt, a sorter panel with three chutes (amber, cyan, green lamps) and a flow bar. on: bits drift to the belt (6 frames); pulling: busy, five bits, the flow bar chases. damaged: glass cracked, chute lamps dead, bar half dead; disabled: cargo jammed in the outlet.
